entities.name: Boron-retaining coupling assignment
observations: Retention of a boron motif in the product argues against ordinary Suzuki-Miyaura coupling if the organoboron carbon is the transferred fragment.
Most plausible classes are boron-preserving borylative cross-coupling or conjunctive/1,2-metallate rearrangement-derived coupling.
Zweifel olefination is less likely without a demonstrable alkenyl-boronate rearrangement.

entities.name: Plausible boron-coupling conditions
observations: Candidate catalysts include Pd(0)/Pd(II) or Ni(0)/Ni(II), with K2CO3, Cs2CO3, KOtBu, or NaOH as bases.
Candidate solvents include dioxane/water, THF/water, toluene, DMF, or NMP.
Boron-preserving variants may require a diboron or boryl-metal reagent, and may use an oxidant or reductant depending on turnover mechanism.

entities.name: Search limitation
observations: The available reaction search did not contain the encoded organoboron substrate or boron-retaining product.
The closest hit was unrelated bromopyridine amination using MTBD and a BrettPhos-family ligand in DMSO at 60 °C.
